content.text: EVIDENCE VIDEOS: 2 videos, total 2:45:00. CITATION RULE: every video moment names its video — "Depo <label> MM:SS" (or H:MM:SS), on that video's own clock. Watch the visuals, not only the speech: deponents point at or mark positions on exhibits, and what is shown can differ from what is said. Compare the videos against each other and against the documents.
VIDEO 1: deposition of Witness B (2:00:00) — file evidence/deposition_witness_B.mp4. Cite moments as "Depo Witness B MM:SS".
VIDEO 2: deposition of Witness D (45:00) — file evidence/deposition_witness_D.mp4. Cite moments as "Depo Witness D MM:SS".
EVIDENCE IMAGE: evidence/exhibit4_intersection_map.png (sent as a 3-second still-frame video; it is a single static image)

GROUND-TRUTH AERIAL of the site (USGS The National Map / USDA NAIP, public domain; sent as a 3-second still-frame video of a single 1600 x 960 image; see "GROUND TRUTH AERIAL" above for scale, rotation and origin). Not case evidence about the event; cite it as "aerial (USGS NAIP)".
Now study all text above, watch both depositions, inspect the exhibit and the aerial, then output the complete, detailed WORLD CONTRACT v2 module in a single ```js block.
